findings.question: q-physics-dynamics-0026
findings.quote: The normal force equals the weight only when the vertical acceleration is zero and just these two vertical forces act.
findings.problem: The added "only when" makes these sufficient conditions necessary. A stationary person on a scale can also have an extra 10 N upward pull and an extra 10 N downward push. Those forces cancel, so the normal force still equals the weight even though more than two vertical forces act.
findings.fix: Replace "only when" with "when" to state sufficient conditions without excluding other balanced cases.
